demand_sampling: Bootstrap historical weekly demand and scale to future weekly forecast mean
current_stock_fallback: Three weeks of forecast demand when no usable current-stock field is available
limitations: Current stock and supplier lead time may be synthetic.
Unit cost may be estimated as 60% of average selling price.
Ordering and holding costs may be assumptions.
Stockout penalty is a scenario assumption.
The simulation is not a verified real-company outcome.
